paragraphs.text: From Jer 40:2-42:7 it seems to be as a parenthesis and separated matter and there this story begins again and this vision is declared what it was.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: And the captain of the guard

paragraphs.text: God moved this infidel to speak this to declare the great blindness and obstinacy of the Jews who could not feel that which this heathen man confessed.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Which was a city of Judah.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Which were scattered abroad for fear of the Chaldeans.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Who was of the king's blood and later slew him, Jer 41:2.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Which were fed also for fear of the Chaldeans.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: For under the colour of entertaining Ishmael, he sought only to make them destroy one another.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: Baalis the king of the Ammonites

paragraphs.text: Thus the godly who think no harm to others are soonest deceived and never lack such as conspire their destruction.
